title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Labor Rates, Parts Discounts and Trip Charges
content:
## Rate card by tier

The labor rate, the overtime multiplier, the trip charge and the discounts on non-covered work billed under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements are published per tier on this card.

| Tier | Discount on the agreement labor rate for repairs that are not covered (percent) | Discount from list price on parts that are not covered (percent) | Regular-hours labor rate billed for non-covered work (USD per hour) | Multiplier applied to the labor rate outside regular hours | Trip charge per demand service call (USD) | Trip charge waived on demand service calls | Lower rate from an active Service Rate Program may replace the agreement labor rate on non-covered repair labor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | 0 | 0 | 148 | 1.5 | 95 | no | yes |
| Inspection Agreement | 5 | 5 | 142 | 1.5 | 95 | no | yes |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | 10 | 10 | 136 | 1.5 | 65 | no | yes |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | 15 | 15 | 128 | 1.5 | 0 | yes | yes |
| Full Coverage Agreement | 20 | 20 | 122 | 1.5 | 0 | yes | yes |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | 25 | 25 | 118 | 1.25 | 0 | yes | no |

### Card notes

- The repair labor discount and the parts discount are the same percentage at every tier: 0 at the Filter & Belt Service Plan, 5 at the Inspection Agreement, 10 at the Preventive Maintenance Agreement, 15 at the Labor Coverage Agreement, 20 at the Full Coverage Agreement and 25 at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.
- The regular-hours labor rate falls tier by tier from 148 USD per hour to 118 USD per hour.
- The overtime multiplier is 1.5 at every tier except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, where it is 1.25.
- The trip charge is 95 USD at the two entry tiers and 65 USD at the Preventive Maintenance Agreement; from the Labor Coverage Agreement upward the trip charge is 0 USD and is waived on demand service calls.
- Rate substitution from an active Service Rate Program is allowed at every tier except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

Two hours of non-covered labor outside regular hours on a unit under a Preventive Maintenance Agreement: the regular-hours rate on this card is 136 USD per hour and the multiplier 1.5, so the hourly rate outside regular hours is 136 USD multiplied by 1.5, that is 204 USD per hour, before the 10 percent repair labor discount that this card also publishes for that tier.
